column1: # known-stars.tsv — Phase 4 tier-A validation corpus for the binary
# catalogue. Each row is one star system the pipeline must reproduce
# correctly; scripts/catalog/known-stars.test.ts drives per-row
# assertions against public/catalog.bin via the catalog-lookup library.
# wds_id                    WDS positional ID (e.g. "06451-1643"). Empty
#                           for single stars.
# system_name               Display name ("Sirius", "α Cen", "Vega").
# primary_hip               Hipparcos number of the primary. Empty for
#                           HIP-less systems (Tycho-only / no HIP). A row
#                           with neither HIP nor Gaia is looked up by
#                           system_name (Sol — the one record addressable
#                           only by proper name).
# primary_gaia_source_id    Gaia DR3 source_id of the primary (int64).
#                           Empty when no Gaia DR3 match exists (e.g.
#                           Sirius A — saturated in Gaia DR3).
# primary_distance_pc       Expected pipeline distance to the primary
#                           in parsecs.
# primary_distance_pc_err   1-sigma uncertainty on primary_distance_pc.
#                           Used in the tolerance gate (see below).
# primary_absmag            Expected absolute magnitude of the primary —
#                           the INTRINSIC (de-extincted) value the build
#                           writes, not observed mag − 5·log(d/10). The
#                           build subtracts the Sol→star Edenhofer A_V so
#                           the runtime raymarch re-adds it without
#                           double-counting; luminous stars behind
#                           measurable dust (Antares, ν Sco, the LMC
#                           supergiants) therefore sit brighter here than
#                           their reddened apparent photometry implies.
# primary_spectral          Expected MK spectral type as a human-readable
#                           string ("A0V", "M5.5Ve", "DA1.9"). The test
#                           parses it via classifyFromSimbad and asserts
#                           classIdx + lumClass match record.spectClass +
#                           record.lumClass. The binary stores only those
#                           two bytes; subclass round-trips through the
#                           resolver but is not pinned in catalog.bin.
# primary_ci                Optional pin on record.ci — the INTRINSIC
#                           (de-reddened) B−V the build writes. Pins the
#                           pipeline value; the canonical literature B−V
#                           is noted in notes_source where it differs.
# primary_radius_rsun       Optional pin on record.physicalRadius (R☉).
#                           Pins the pipeline value; canonical published
#                           radii noted in notes_source.
# radius_rel_tol            Optional per-row relative tolerance for
#                           primary_radius_rsun (default 0.10).
# companions                Semicolon-separated tuples:
#                             comp_letter:hip:gaia_id:absmag[:max_sep_au]
#                           Empty for single-star rows. Components with
#                           no HIP leave the hip slot empty
#                           hip + gaia_id + absmag are pulled from
#                           data/binaries/multiples.tsv, which is
#                           itself the validation target —
#                           SIMBAD spot-checks the primaries).
#                           Optional max_sep_au pins the companion's
#                           catalog.bin xyz to within that many AU of
#                           the primary's catalog.bin xyz. Used to
#                           regression-guard synth-promoted companions
#                           whose tangent-projected position depends on
#                           the route-detector in companion-promotion
#                           (Algol Ab/Aa2, Polaris Ab, Capella Ab).
# orbital_period_days       Expected pipeline orbital period in days
#                           (companion record .periodDays). Empty when
#                           the system lacks a well-determined orbit or
#                           the pipeline does not propagate one.
# var_type                  Optional GCVS variability pin: "pulsating" /
#                           "eclipsing" / "other" asserts record.varType
#                           against the catalog-pure VAR_TYPE_* enum;
#                           "none" asserts the record carries NO
#                           variability (varType, period, amplitude all
#                           zero). Empty = no varType assertion.
# var_period_days           Optional GCVS published period in days,
#                           UNQUANTISED. The test applies the build's
#                           encoding (round(P × 10) into uint16, 0.1 d
#                           quanta, 6553.5 d clamp) before comparing to
#                           record.periodDays.
# var_amp_mag               Optional GCVS amplitude (max − min, mag),
#                           unquantised. Encoded as round(amp × 20)
#                           into uint8 (0.05 mag quanta, 12.75 clamp)
#                           before comparing to record.amplitudeMag.
# tier                      Required regression-tier tag. Enum, rejected
#                           at load when blank or unrecognised:
#                             standard            no distance-refinement
#                                                 layer under test
#                             bj-override         Bailer-Jones re-anchor
#                                                 of a catastrophic
#                                                 AT-HYG G_R3 distance
#                             bj-no-degradation   well-measured nearby
#                                                 row B-J must not shift
#                             lmc-kinematic-snap  LMC kinematic snap to
#                                                 the Pietrzyński anchor
#                           Single/visual-binary partitioning is derived
#                           from the companions cell, not tagged here.
# notes_source              Provenance citation. Required on every row.
#                           Format: "SIMBAD <permalink>" /
#                           "ORB6 entry P=…" / "Gaia DR3 ADQL
#                           spot-check 2026-MM-DD" / "Pietrzyński 2019
#                           LMC distance". Prose only — the machine-read
#                           tag is the tier column.
# Asserted by known-stars.test.ts:
#   primary_distance_pc       ±0.01 pc OR 1-sigma, whichever is larger
#   primary_absmag            ±0.05
#   primary_spectral          classIdx (record.spectClass) exact match;
#                             lumClass exact match unless the row's
#                             spectral string is bare-class (no Roman).
#   primary_ci                ±0.03 (float32 + Ballesteros round-trip)
#   primary_radius_rsun       ±10% relative, or the row's radius_rel_tol
#   companion absmag          ±0.05
#   companion hip / gaia_id   exact match
#   orbital_period_days       ±5% (only checked when row has a value)
#   var_type                  exact enum match ("none" = all three zero)
#   var_period_days           exact after uint16 0.1 d quantisation
#   var_amp_mag               exact after uint8 0.05 mag quantisation
# Every row carries notes_source — no row added without a traceable
# citation. Distance + absmag verified against AT LEAST TWO independent
# sources where possible (SIMBAD + Gaia DR3 ADQL; ORB6 + van Leeuwen
# HIP2; etc.). Companion rows use multiples.tsv as one source;
# SIMBAD per-oid as the second. Variability pins quote the GCVS 5.1
# published period + max/min magnitudes (the pipeline input is the
# same frozen GCVS snapshot, so these pins are parse + cross-match +
# encode regression guards; AAVSO / SIMBAD otype spot-checks noted in
# notes_source where consulted). The TSV is the contract — the
# vitest exercises every row, every column.
# Tab-separated. Lines beginning with "#" are skipped by the parser.
# Empty cells render as adjacent tabs.
wds_id
column18: notes_source

column18: Sol — no HIP, no Gaia source_id, no SIMBAD row; classified via the curated Sol special-case in stars-parse.ts (G2V) and addressed by name in the harness. ci = AT-HYG B−V 0.656 (canonical 0.653); R = 1.035 R☉ from the Stefan-Boltzmann chain (canonical 1.0 — the calibration point).

SIMBAD * alf CMa sp_type=A0mA1Va; HIP2 parallax 379.21 mas → 2.637 pc. Gaia-saturated (no source_id); spectral via the SIMBAD HIP fallback tier. ci 0.009 (canonical B−V 0.00). R pins the pipeline value 1.915 R☉ with rel_tol 0.15: canonical interferometric 1.711 (Kervella+ 2003) sits ~12% below — the class-table BC for the Am composite overshoots slightly; the pin catches regressions past that known offset.

SIMBAD * alf Lyr sp_type=A0V; HIP2 parallax 130.23 mas. Bright star saturated in Gaia DR3 (no source_id); spectral resolves via resolveSpectralInfo's SIMBAD HIP fallback tier. GCVS alf Lyr: DSCTC P=0.19 d, amp V -0.02→0.07 (0.09), pinned pulsating (DSCTC subtype-tail).

SIMBAD * alf Aql sp_type=A7Vn; HIP2 parallax. Bright star, no Gaia DR3 match. GCVS alf Aql: DSCTC P=0.06342 d, amp V (0.004) — parenthesised amplitude notation (the once-dropped GCVS notation class); 0.004 mag quantises to ampUnits=0, so the pin asserts period + type with amplitude below the 0.05-mag encoding quantum.

SIMBAD * alf UMi sp_type=F8Ib; Cepheid variable. GCVS alf UMi: DCEPS P=3.9696 d, amp V 1.86→2.13 (0.27), pinned pulsating (DCEPS first-overtone subtype-tail). HIP-anchored distance; Gaia-saturated (no source_id), spectral resolves via the SIMBAD HIP fallback tier. ORB6 inner orbit Aa,Ab P=10744 d (29.4 yr); companion Ab promoted via synth-02318+8916-Ab (no own gaia/hip). max_sep_au=20.0 clamps the sep+PA projection — Ab projects to 13.26 AU from Polaris via sep+PA (0.1″ × 132.626 pc); without the clamp the athyg_position float residue landed it 128 AU off. Anchor flux solve: AT-HYG's 1.98 blends Aa+Ab (WDS dmag 2.0), anchor re-split -3.643 -> -3.485, Ab at anchor+2.0.
SIMBAD * alf CMi sp_type=F5IV-V+DQZ; HIP2 parallax. Bright primary, no Gaia DR3 match.

SIMBAD * alf Ori sp_type=M1-M2Ia-Iab; semi-regular variable. GCVS alf Ori: SRC P=2335 d, amp V 0.0→1.6. HIP-anchored. NO companion expected: the WDS Aa,Ab row carries no mags and no orbit, so the promoted Ab was a full-luminosity invented twin of Betelgeuse (absmag -5.47 at 0.1″) — the inherited-photometry drop now removes it. If Ab reappears here, the twin-brightness guard regressed.
SIMBAD * alf Boo sp_type=K1.5IIIFe-0.5. Bright nearby giant; Gaia-saturated (no source_id), spectral resolves via the SIMBAD HIP fallback tier.
SIMBAD * alf Tau sp_type=K5+III. Bright giant, no Gaia DR3 match.
SIMBAD * bet Ori sp_type=B8Ia. Bright supergiant.

SIMBAD * alf Sco sp_type=M1.5Iab+B2Vn. Bright red supergiant with B-star companion. Sightline crosses the Ophiuchus complex edge (Edenhofer A_V≈0.84, matching literature 0.6–0.8); the de-extincted pins track the dust-encode fidelity, and the 673 R☉ radius sits inside the published 680±100 range.

SIMBAD * alf Vir sp_type=B1V. Bright early-B variable, tight spectroscopic binary. GCVS alf Vir: ELL+BCEP P=4.014604 d, amp V 0.95→(0.10) — parenthesised amplitude notation (the once-dropped GCVS notation class); ELL classifies eclipsing (ellipsoidal), which also drives wings + pulsation suppression. Anchor dimmed by flux conservation once the MSC Aa,Ab/Aa1,Aa2 pair mags landed (V=0.97 is the blend; A-alone is ~0.25 mag fainter).
SIMBAD * alf Cyg sp_type=A2Ia. Bright supergiant; AT-HYG distance from HIP2 with high uncertainty (true distance ~800 pc per Gaia DR2).

SIMBAD * alf Aur sp_type=G3III:. Bright quad system (Aa+Ab giants); HIP-anchored. ORB6 inner orbit Aa,Ab P=104.02 d; companion Ab promoted via synth-05167+4600-Ab (no own gaia/hip). max_sep_au=1.0 clamps the sep+PA projection — Ab projects to ~0 AU from Capella via sep+PA (0.0″ at 13.123 pc); BinaryOrbitField overlays the ~0.74 AU inner orbit at runtime. AT-HYG magnitude is the Aa+Ab combined light; the dmag joint split re-allocates it, leaving Aa at 0.19 (canonical M_V~0.14). System distance coherence: the clean-Gaia H/L companions anchor the root at 13.334 pc; Capella itself (Gaia-saturated, HIP2 13.12) snaps within the combined parallax noise.
SIMBAD * alf Car sp_type=A9II. Bright supergiant; Gaia-saturated (no source_id), spectral resolves via the SIMBAD HIP fallback tier.

SIMBAD * alf Eri sp_type=B6Vpe; emission-line Be star, rapid rotator. Anchor flux solve: AT-HYG's V=0.46 blends A+B; WDS speckle pair mags (0.7/2.1, non-V) drive the split, so B's V share is overstated — published M_V(A) is -2.77.
SIMBAD * alf PsA sp_type=A4V. Nearby A-dwarf with debris disc. var_type=none guards against a false-positive GCVS cross-match (not a GCVS variable; varType/period/amplitude must all stay zero).

SIMBAD V* R Lep sp_type=C7,6e (Hind's Crimson Star, carbon Mira); B-J photogeo 446.3 pc (SIMBAD plx 2.19±0.06 → 456±13, consistent). GCVS R Lep: M P=427.07 d, amp V 5.5→11.7 (6.2). Absmag re-pinned for the Riello G−V cascade: V is now transformed Gaia photometry rather than AT-HYG's printed mag.

SIMBAD * gam02 Vel sp_type=WC8+O7.5III-V (WR 11, closest Wolf-Rayet); Gaia-saturated (no source_id), HIP2 long-baseline 342.5 pc (plx 2.92±0.30). V=1.83 → M_V≈-5.84 plus A_V≈0.16 de-extinction. Covers the WR population. physicalRadius (~19 R☉, sized by the V-dominant O7.5III companion) is pinned at unit level in catalog-pure.test.ts; the corpus schema has no radius column. DISTANCE AND ABSMAG PIN KNOWN-WRONG VALUES, 392.293 pc / -6.296 against the interferometric 336 +8/-7 pc (North et al. 2007) and the 342.5 pc HIP2 long-baseline this row pinned before. Cause: the primaries now admit gamma1 Vel (HD 68243) as a record, so system distance coherence sees two members of WDS 08095-4720 and anchors on gamma1 — whose Gaia parallax (2.6052+/-0.1235) is the least precise of the system's four Gaia members and whose Bailer-Jones placement is 392.293 pc. The three better-measured members (331-343 pc) arrive as promoted companions, after the coherence pass has run. absmag follows by brightness invariance, 5*log10(392.293/342.466)=0.295. primary_radius_rsun is left UNPINNED rather than pinned wrong: it derives from the bad absmag (19.15 -> 21.937 R☉). All three revert to truth pins when stellata-uadc.40 lands.
